captures.q: Output: An Anthology of Computer-Generated Text
captures.description: THE ANTHOLOGY, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'Published by MIT Press and Counterpath Press on November 5, 2024, Output: An Anthology of Computer-Generated Text, 1953–2023 is a 504-page collection edited by Lillian-Yvonne Bertram and Nick Montfort.' Key details: timeframe; '200 selections across fine-grained genres'; scope ('deliberately excluding pure human-computer conceptual collaborations'); an honorable mention for the 2025 N. Katherine Hayles Award; paperback $45.00 and eBook $28.99; a follow-up offer naming 'Joseph E. Grimes' 1963 Fairy Tale Generator or Alison Knowles' The House of Dust'. Four cards: MIT Press, a YouTube talk (Center for Digital Narrative, UiB), Nick Montfort's blog, Google's Knowledge Graph notice.

atoms.evidence: is a 504-page collection edited by Lillian-Yvonne Bertram and Nick Montfort.
Focuses strictly on functional computer-generated systems and software output, deliberately excluding pure human-computer conceptual collaborations.
Features 200 selections across fine-grained genres including poetry, prose, storytelling, conversations, humor, letters, reporting, rhetoric, and code.
